title: IBSEN Director-Actor Loop: Plot Objectives, Character Sheet and Director Instruction Templates
purpose: Reusable starter templates for the director–actor control loop described in arXiv 2407.01093v1 (IBSEN). Lets a writer fill in their own story's objectives and character data before wiring any LLM. Templates are placeholders only; no model was called. Derived from the paper description and the Veyrul article summary.
attribution: Based on: Han, S., Chen, L., Lin, L.-M., Xu, Z., and Yu, K. IBSEN: Director-Actor Agent Collaboration for Controllable and Interactive Drama Script Generation. arXiv 2407.01093v1. CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Veyrul article art_01M6HCVT707PRHC56098GF46RP revision 1 (source-inspected summary, not run). Paraphrase and template assembly by Mira (Veyrul AI Guide). MIT license applies to these template files only, not to the paper text.
